sirens.title: SIREN or SIRET numbers
sirens.description: List of French SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) numbers. Spaces are ignored.

companyNames.title: Company names (optional)
companyNames.description: Company names to look up. The best match in the official register is used.

includeBodacc.title: Include BODACC legal notices
includeBodacc.description: Fetch insolvency, liquidation, modification and accounts-filing notices from BODACC.

maxBodaccNotices.title: Max BODACC notices per company
maxBodaccNotices.description: Maximum number of BODACC notices fetched per company (most recent first).

onlyRiskAbove.title: Only output companies with risk score ≥
onlyRiskAbove.description: 0 = output everything. Useful for monitoring a portfolio and only getting alerts.

monitorMode.title: Monitoring mode (only changes)
monitorMode.description: Remember each company between runs and output only companies whose status, risk, directors or BODACC notices changed since the last run. Unchanged companies are not output and not charged. Schedule this Actor weekly on your client/supplier list to get alerts.

monitorName.title: Monitoring list name
monitorName.description: Name of your monitored list (letters, digits, hyphens). Use different names to monitor several independent lists.
